text:
ajay (partnerships): Hey folks :wave: kicking off sync with EdgeResell about bundling open-models on their appliance + cloud marketplace listing. Need to align licensing, export, and announcement timing.

olivia (pm): Quick context — partner wants to pre-install a quantized variant and sell as 'EdgeResell AI kit'. They asked if redistribution allowed and whether we can co-brand.

tess (legal): Short answer: depends on model license + weights provenance. For open weights with permissive license we can allow redistribution, but must check attribution and export controls (EAR). Need supplier attestations.

marco (marketplace): Marketplace side: we need SKU + asset metadata, screenshots, and EULA text 2 weeks before launch. Also embargo window for joint announcement.

nina (hw-sdks): From HW side, need a small runtime bundle (libredwood-lite) and explicit quantization profile for their edge GPU. Also KMS integration note: if customer wants keys on HSM, need our private offering consumed by partner.

ajay (partnerships): Action items proposal: 1) legal: model provenance attestation from supplier; 2) eng-ml: produce quantized artifacts + runtime; 3) marketplace: draft SKU + listing; 4) marketing: draft joint press copy and embargo date. Thoughts?

tess (legal): Add export-compliance check (EAR/ITAR). If model trained on uncontrolled data and weights are public, lower risk but still need supplier COI (certificate of origin). I'll draft clauses.

marco (marketplace): Proposed timeline: 6-week cadence. Week 1-2: legal + compliance, Week 3: eng deliverables, Week 4: partner validation, Week 5: marketplace prep, Week 6: joint announcement. We can compress to 4 weeks if supplier is responsive.

nina (hw-sdks): Technical risk: quantization may change model quality — want eval baseline and regression thresholds. Also include a fallback variant for hosted-only customers (no redistribution) to avoid support mix-ups.

olivia (pm): Marketing asks: embargo date? Partner wants announcement at partner summit on May 10. That gives us 5 weeks from today. Can we make it?

ajay (partnerships): Sounds tight but doable if legal signs attestation by EOD Wednesday and ML team starts quantizing tomorrow. I'll ping partner.

devbot: Reminder set: /remind @ajay to follow up with partner at 2024-05-01 10:00

tess (legal): Draft clause snippet for redistribution: ```text
Redistribution permitted for binary quantized weights only; source weights remain governed by original license; partner must not relicense; partner must include attribution and link to original model page; supplier must provide COI and export self-attestation.
```

marco (marketplace): Marketplace fields we need: SKU, short description (<=120 chars), icons (512px), privacy policy link, EULA text. Also checkbox if redistributed model is allowed in that region.

ajay (partnerships): Noted. I'll consolidate into a one-pager and post here. Can someone volunteer to take the SKU + listing draft?

olivia (pm): I'll own the marketplace draft.

nina (hw-sdks): I'll coordinate runtime + quantization with eng-ml.

tess (legal): I'll draft legal attestation and clause.

marco (marketplace): I'll reserve the listing slot and coordinate screenshots.

ajay (partnerships): Great. Quick ask — partner's legal asked if we require an indemnity clause. Tess?

tess (legal): For redistributed binary weights, we prefer a limited indemnity focused on IP claims and export breaches. I'll propose language and a short onboarding questionnaire for suppliers.

ajay (partnerships): Thanks. I'll post the one-pager by EOD and ping EdgeResell. :thumbsup:
